description: This file defines date range presets and functions for calculating date ranges based on presets, used in a data table feature.

methods.name: getCompatiblePresets
methods.description: Returns preset options compatible with the specified date range filter.

methods.name: getDefaultStartDate
methods.description: Returns the default start date (6 days ago, start of day).

methods.name: getDefaultEndDate
methods.description: Returns the default end date (end of current day).

methods.name: getDateRangeFromPreset
methods.description: Generates start and end dates based on a preset value.

methods.name: recalculateDateRange
methods.description: Recalculates date range filter values based on current preset and date.
